summary.note: recoverable_object_rate is over adjudicated REAL actions. A sentence that is not an action at all is not a missing buyer, and counting it as one would send every wave to improve an extractor that was already right to refuse.

verdict: The bottleneck is NOT where wave 8 left it. Of 37 refusals, 22 (59.5%) are sentences that announce nothing — release cadences, navigation, benefit copy, customer testimonials, definitions of what a release IS. The object extractor was right to refuse every one of them, and the defect is upstream in what the ACTION detector admitted. Of the 15 that are real actions, 6 (40%) have the missing dimension present in the document and were missed.
ordering: 1. action-detector precision — 22 of 37 refusals should never have been actions
2. object-extraction recall — 6 of 15 real actions are recoverable today
3. source content — 9 of 15 real actions genuinely do not name a buyer
